title: Persistent Google Profiles and Configurable Limits

origin.summary: Plan durable, spoof-resistant Google-linked Aegis profiles and configurable per-profile rate and quota enforcement.

events.note: Created as pending design work; no automatic profile provisioning or limit enforcement was implemented.
Activated to implement provider-neutral verified identity admission and profile limits.
Implemented closed-by-default admission, durable verified identity binding, configurable request/execution/concurrency limits, and management routes with focused verification.
